name: Plockton
method: tidetimes.org.uk Plockton vs its own Ullapool (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Ullapool: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: HW and LW heights each = offset + scale * Ullapool; the two maps cross at ~2.1 m on Ullapool, inside the range. LW is 7 min before Ullapool to within a minute or two, HW 13 min before but scattering ~7 min. Heights follow tidetimes, Ullapool's Z0 is set to UKHO's level. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Plockton vs Ullapool, 2025-10-01 to 2026-12-01 (every 3 day(s), 554 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
